title: torilis helvetica var. purpurea
intro: Torilis helvetica var. purpurea, commonly known as Purple Hemlock or Purple Bristle-bell, is a plant species in the carrot family (Apiaceae) that is native to Europe and Western Asia. The health benefits of Torilis helvetica var. purpurea include its potential to aid in digestion and relieve symptoms of menopause, such as hot flashes and night sweats. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Torilis helvetica var. purpurea include coumarins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
